description: pulp_wars-9s0.9: the start of player 1's round-28 turn in a 14 x 14 Dry Land Martian mirror (seed 9) where the Normal AI before the fix repeated REDEVELOP and BUILD_LUMBER_CAMP on (10, 5) until its Coins ran out. pulp_wars-1wy.3: state re-identified as pulp-wars-poc-7r37 and given the two empty per-turn Martian lists (`beamedThisTurn`, `tractorUsedThisTurn`); its thirteen Grunts at the balance round's maximum HP (maxHp 9, hp clamped). pulp_wars-jdb.3: state re-identified as pulp-wars-poc-7r38 and given the four empty Candy lists (`sugarRush`, `crumbs`, `splattedThisTurn`, `tossedThisTurn`). pulp_wars-1wy.6: state re-identified as pulp-wars-poc-7r39; its thirteen Grunts at the 8 HP of the fallback (maxHp 8, hp clamped). pulp_wars-ykw.2: state re-identified as pulp-wars-poc-7r40 and its setup renamed to map revision `REGIONAL_BIOMES_NAVAL_V3`; the board is unchanged. pulp_wars-if6: state re-identified as pulp-wars-poc-7r41 (3 starting Coins, tier 3 technology base cost 9); the state is otherwise unchanged. pulp_wars-w49.16: state re-identified as pulp-wars-poc-7r54 (the economy rejig): every Monument gives 3 population and every mill counts all of its owner's contributors next to it, so the live population of the cities was recomputed (a level a city reaches by it has the Treasury, or the level's Coin reward, recorded); a `JUGGERNAUT` reward recorded at level 5 is recorded as `TREASURY` (the giant is a level-6 reward now; the units stay).
